d.ko: A winter-themed romcom visual novel with four main heroines and one mysterious cat-like creature! In a town where tradition and modernity meet, protagonist Shingo Uryu's whole life changes when he begins attending the prestigious Yuihime Girls Private Academy...
d.en: A winter-themed romcom visual novel with four main heroines and one mysterious cat-like creature! In a town where tradition and modernity meet, protagonist Shingo Uryu's whole life changes when he begins attending the prestigious Yuihime Girls Private Academy...
d.zh: 一款以冬季为主题的爱情喜剧视觉小说，有四位女主角和一只神秘的猫型生物！ 在一座传统与现代交融的小镇，主角瓜生新吾转学到著名的私立结姬女子学园。从此，他的生活彻底改变……
